description: Source code for DHCPv4 server management commands within Zephyr OS, including start, stop, and status functions, with internal helper functions and command registration.

methods.name: cmd_net_dhcpv4_server_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv4 server on a specified network interface with a base address.

methods.name: cmd_net_dhcpv4_server_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv4 server on a specified network interface.

methods.name: cmd_net_dhcpv4_server_status
methods.description: Displays the current status of the DHCPv4 server on a specified or default interface.

methods.name: dhcpv4_addr_state_to_str
methods.description: Converts DHCPv4 address state enum to string.

methods.name: dhcpv4_lease_cb
methods.description: Callback function to process and display DHCPv4 lease information.
